name: Craftsman Automation Ltd
title: Craftsman Automation Ltd - 543276 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Powertrain utilisation only ~65-70% and alloy wheels at ~3M annualised exit vs 5.5M capacity, with management deferring further alloy expansion; FY27 growth guided mid-teens and capex undecided until September.

utilisation.quote: Overall, if you take that new powertrain business also into consideration, our capacity utilization is around 60%.

capex.quote: We want to wait and watch on this matter. We are looking at the commodity prices pass through on the aluminum pricing.

triggers.label: Alloy wheel exit ~3M vs 5.5M capacity
triggers.quote: our exit rate is around close to 3 million (nos) on the annualized basis as of March, and our capacity is around 5.5 million (nos).

triggers.label: Alloy wheel expansion deferred past FY26
triggers.quote: I don't think we'll take a decision in this financial year to further stretch the alloy wheel capacity.

triggers.label: Powertrain utilisation 65-70%
triggers.quote: Powertrain, we are still at around 65%, 70% because there are some pockets and segments where the customers are not doing well.

triggers.label: FY27 revenue growth mid-teens
triggers.quote: It is truly double digit, most probably, in the mid-teens, I would say.

triggers.label: Sunbeam margins still single-digit, reset underway
triggers.quote: We are just lacking behind on the margin-wise with a single, still at single-digit for various reasons.

guidance.quote: It is truly double digit, most probably, in the mid-teens, I would say.
it'll be less than 2, I would say, in the coming, the current year itself, totally. And then it'll go down further to 1.5.
I think it will be 2 to 3 years' time.
we will be able to reach that $100 million sort of revenue in '29, '30.

red_flags.label: Working capital outflow INR600 crore FY26 after INR400 crore FY25
red_flags.quote: in FY 2025 there was a negative working capital impact of about INR400 crores, and FY 2026 there's another INR600 crores.

red_flags.label: Labour cost inflation and manpower pressure
red_flags.quote: What is worrying us the inflationary manpower cost, which is very difficult to pass on to customer.

evasions.quote: On FY 2027 itself, we are not very clear about the capex as today
We will see the results coming into Q2 from Sunbeam.
